# -- final certificate ------------------------------------------------
    def state(self):
        M = self.M
        L = self.L
        R = self.R
        C = self.C
        counters = [[[C[(l * R + r) * M + q] for r in range(R)]
                     for q in range(M)] for l in range(L)]
        p_id = self.p_id
        stage = self.p_stage
        queues = []
        for q in range(M):
            tail = self.fifo[q][self.fhead[q]:]
            queues.append({'fifo': [p_id[idx] for idx in tail
                                    if stage[idx] == S_FIFO],
                           'pifo': [p_id[key[1]] for key in self.pifo[q]],
                           'fifo_bytes': self.fbytes[q],
                           'pifo_bytes': self.pbytes[q]})
        ahead = self.services_ahead
        base = self.p_base
        lags = sorted(([p_id[idx], ahead(rank) - base[idx]]
                       for rank, idx in self.live), key=lambda item: item[0])
        sc = self.sc
        return {'tick': sc[K_T],
                'load_balancer': sc[K_L],
                'service_bank': sc[K_P],
                'sample_progress': sc[K_A],
                'borders': list(self.borders),
                'counters': counters,
                'history': list(self.H),
                'policy': self.policy.certificate(self),
                'queues': queues,
                'lags': lags}
